summary: Completed comprehensive testing of Daleel Pets Phase 2 features including Tier 1 crawler, alerts system, competitor profiles, and store registry with crawl status tracking. All 202 products and 7 stores verified working correctly.
passed_tests: My Products page displays 202 products with KPIs (48,020 units sold, 5,038,312.54 SAR revenue)
Store Registry shows 7 stores with Phase 2 crawl status columns (Crawl Status, Tier, Last Crawled)
Tier 1 crawler attempts real HTTP calls to Salla stores (graceful failure as expected)
Crawl log expansion shows crawl history for stores
Store name navigation to Competitor Profile pages
Competitor Profile displays KPIs, revenue trends, top products, category distribution
Revenue trend chart with weekly/daily toggle functionality
Alerts page with create/delete/toggle alert functionality
Alert feed shows events and Check Now button works
Sidebar navigation with 4 items (My Products, Insights, Alerts, Stores)
All backend APIs returning correct responses (27/27 tests passed)
POST /api/stores/{id}/crawl triggers real HTTP crawl with graceful fallback
Store profiles endpoint (/api/stores/{id}/profile) with competitor analysis
